text:
A powerful brawler who builds inner Chi through combat.

Primary: STR | Secondary: CON

MP mechanic: MP = Chi, builds from hitting mobs and Meditate - never decays. Activate Tiger Stance to double Chi generation. At 100 Chi, transform with Beast Form.

Skills:
Kick - fast strike
Sweeping Kick - frontal AoE
Meditate - Chi + MP restore
Tiger Stance - STR/DEX/speed buff + double Chi
Roundhouse - spinning kick AoE
One Inch Punch - massive damage + 2-tile pushback
Alpha Strike - blink to 3 targets
Counter Strike - negate next hit + counter stun
Chi Burst - release all Chi as AoE
Beast Form - transform into Fenrir/Celestial/Basilisk
